page_title: MNU 0-3 MCI | Manchester Utd v Manchester City 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) as his effort only hit the wall.
90+4' Paul Tierney interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jonny Evans (Manchester United). Manchester City win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90+4' Manchester City take a short corner kick.
90+3' What was Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

90+3' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
90+2' Antony (Manchester United) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 73502.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
88' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Manchester Utd win a corner.
87' That will be all from Jack Grealish who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
87' Substitution. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) has come on for Julian Alvarez.
86' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Christian Eriksen will be replaced by Antony (Manchester United).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anthony Martial (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch so that Marcus Rashford can be given a rest.
86' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
86' Corner kick. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is ready to send the ball into the box.
85' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
84' John Stones (Manchester City) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle.
84' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ederson, who smothers the ball.
82' Phil Foden (Manchester City) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
80' 0 - 3 Goal! Erling Haaland puts the ball across the area and Phil Foden (Manchester City) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 0:3.
80' Rodri (Manchester City) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Andre Onana easily deals with the threat.
77' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:11.
75' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
75' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
75' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Here is a change. Rasmus Hojlund is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Victor Lindelof trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United).
72' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' A pass into the box finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Andre Onana denies him.

69' Christian Eriksen dinks a lofted pass into the path of Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) inside the box, but his drive sails a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
68' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' A dangerous looking corner kick from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
65' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

61' Manchester City slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
59' A sweet pass inside the box gives Jack Grealish (Manchester City) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!

57' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the right post, but Andre Onana makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

56' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
54' A pass from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is intercepted by Andre Onana and the move breaks down.
51' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) makes the score 0:2 after burying a close-range header into the roof of the net after a good run and cross by Bernardo Silva.
49' Phil Foden (Manchester City) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.

48' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Ederson pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
48' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
48' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The manager makes a subsitution with Mason Mount (Manchester United) coming on for Sofyan Amrabat.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Manchester City is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+4' What a save from Andre Onana! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.

45+3' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
45+2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45+2' A cross into the box from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is cleared.
45+1' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
45+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes it short.
45+1' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Ederson thwarts him with a nice save.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.
42' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) picks up a yellow card.
42' Caution goes to Phil Foden (Manchester City).
42' Phil Foden (Manchester City) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Paul Tierney blows his whistle for an infringement.
42' The total number of attempts is 2:6.
40' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared.
39' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Manchester City.
38' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.

38' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the roof of the net but is denied by Andre Onana, who pulls off a glorious save! The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
37' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Paul Tierney signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Manchester City.
36' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

36' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
34' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

31' Rasmus Hojlund pulls the ball back to Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
29' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andre Onana into the bottom right corner.
26' The referee gives a yellow card to Andre Onana (Manchester United).
25' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
25' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Manchester City!

24' Play continues despite the shouts by some Manchester City players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Paul Tierney interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
22' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
22' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Paul Tierney blows for a foul. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' The corner from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is cleared away by the defence.

20' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Andre Onana has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
20' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City).
19' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) plays a one-two with Bernardo Silva, but the move breaks down. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
16' Rodri (Manchester City) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
16' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
14' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) is penalised for holding. Paul Tierney signals a set piece.
14' Manchester Utd are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

11' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
9' The resulting corner from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) comes to nothing.
8' Phil Foden (Manchester City) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
7' Wonderful movement by Manchester Utd. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
4' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

2' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Ederson.
2' Good movement by Victor Lindelof (Manchester United), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will supervise the game today.
